**Dropnook 2.2.1** — Cert Warden's address as you copy it.

* **`CERTWARDEN_ENDPOINT_URL`** now takes any of Cert Warden's addresses: the server itself (`https://certwarden.example.org:4050`), the page you have open in the browser (`…/certwarden/app/`) or the API. With the app page, 2.2.0 asked the wrong address and got no certificate.
* **Half set up?** If some Cert Warden settings are there but not all, the log of drop now says which are missing — for example when an older `compose.yaml` does not pass them on.

Nothing to change on your side: *Check for Updates* → *Update*.
